messages:
clare.pm: Heads up — we need to lock GA acceptance criteria for Predict v1. Scope: SLA windows, docs, oncall routing, monitoring signals, and pricing tiers. Target: decisions by EOD Friday so legal/commercial can finalize. Quick sync?

michael.eng: Can we list the minimal SLOs? I think 99.9% p99 latency < 250ms is the ask for hosted tier

anya.growth: A few enterprise pilot customers asked for 99.95% with dedicated capacity. Need to know if we classify that as 'enterprise-only' SLA.

thomas.sre: +1 on splits. Proposal: Hosted standard = 99.9 p99 <250ms, Hosted premium = 99.95 p99 <200ms, Dedicated = 99.99 uptime SLA with a dedicated runbook.

sara.support: If premium requires different escalation, we need to confirm oncall rotations and handoff docs. We're short on weekend coverage for premium today.

michael.eng: For monitoring, we should surface these in Console: latency_by_model, error_rate, kv_cache_hit_ratio. Also add regression alerts tied to evals.

devops-bot: doc uploaded: https://redwood.example.com/docs/predict/ga-criteria-draft (edited) :link:

clare.pm: thomas, can you paste the alert rule we'll want in the runbook? keep it simple.

thomas.sre: Sure — snippet:

```
alert: HighPredictP99
expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(predict_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 0.25
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: 'Predict p99 > 250ms'
```

(we'll adapt thresholds per tier)

anya.growth: Pricing note — growth customers expect a 'pay-as-you-go' hosted tier, and a predictable monthly committed plan for enterprise. We need a table in docs mapping latency/SLA to price bands.

michael.eng: For rollout, recommend phased GA: 1) public hosted standard, 2) premium by invite, 3) dedicated reserved. Canary policy: 5% traffic first 48h.

sara.support: Please add a short troubleshooting checklist to docs: common causes (model OOM, KV eviction, network throttling) and owner contacts.

clare.pm: Action items — @thomas.sre draft runbook + alerts by Tue; @michael.eng confirm canary infra and burst capacity config; @sara.support draft routing + weekend coverage proposal; @anya.growth finalize pricing tiers and one-pager for sales. I'll consolidate into the doc linked by Wed EOD. :spiral_calendar:

michael.eng: noted

thomas.sre: putting a PR in for runbook now

sara.support: I'll sync with ops scheduling and post a doc by Wed morning

devops-bot: deploy reminder: Predict v1 canary window scheduled Thu 02:00 UTC — set your notification preferences :bell:
